analyze_signal_trend.description:
Within-recording feature trend — screening only, NOT a prognosis.

Segments a single recording (seconds of data) and fits a trend on the
per-segment feature values. Use it to screen whether a recording is
stationary. It cannot estimate Remaining Useful Life: for RUL, collect
repeated measurements over days/weeks and pass them to estimate_rul.

analysis_scope.description: Always 'within_recording_screening': this trend spans seconds of one recording, not the machine's life
analysis_scope.title: Analysis Scope

baseline_segments.description: Number of leading segments used as the baseline window. Onset is only searched AFTER this window; degradation starting inside the baseline cannot be detected by this method.
baseline_segments.title: Baseline Segments

feature_series.description: Per-segment feature values (evenly subsampled to at most 50 points). One recording yields ONE point for estimate_rul (e.g. the recording's overall feature value) — accumulate recordings over time to build its input series.
feature_series.title: Feature Series

onset_detected.description: Whether a degradation onset was detected after the baseline window (first value exceeding baseline mean + onset_threshold_sigma * std)
onset_detected.title: Onset Detected

onset_segment_index.description: Segment index where degradation starts (always >= baseline_segments); None when no onset detected
onset_segment_index.title: Onset Segment Index

onset_threshold_sigma.description: Baseline standard deviations used as the onset trigger

onset_time_s.description: Center time (s) of the onset segment within the recording
onset_time_s.title: Onset Time S

p_value.description: Two-sided p-value of the slope (None when not computable)
p_value.title: P Value

r_squared.description: R-squared goodness of fit of the linear trend
r_squared.title: R Squared

segment_times_s.description: Segment center times in seconds for feature_series (same subsampling)
segment_times_s.title: Segment Times S

series_truncated.description: True when feature_series was subsampled to the 50-point cap
series_truncated.title: Series Truncated

slope.description: Trend slope in feature units per second (within the recording)
slope.title: Slope

trend_direction.description: increasing, decreasing, or stable — based on the slope significance test (p < 0.05), not on an R-squared cutoff

Statistical analysis result of the signal.

Values are in the signal's native unit. The unit is reported only when
DECLARED (companion ``_metadata.json`` or ``load_signal(signal_unit=...)``)
— it is never guessed from signal amplitude.

signal_unit.description: Declared signal unit ('g', 'm/s2', 'mm/s', 'm/s') from companion metadata — never guessed from amplitude. None when not declared.
signal_unit.title: Signal Unit

unit_note.description: Unit declaration status and how to declare the unit for ISO severity assessment
unit_note.title: Unit Note

analyze_statistics.title: StatisticalResult

assess_asset_change.description:
Outcome of ``assess_asset_change``: the change of one measurement point
against its reference, or a typed reason why it cannot be assessed.

``status`` discriminates: 'assessed' fills reference, lineage, observed,
derived, assessed, comparability and suggested_verification;
'not_found' names the known assets and points with a suggestion;
'insufficient_history' reports available versus required with a remedy;
'processing_not_homogeneous' reports the snapshot lineages and the
re-processing remedy. The reference is a declared baseline only when
one was declared (health_declared True); otherwise it is the automatic
window of the first comparable acquisitions, a relative comparison
whose health is not declared.

assessed.description: The verdict: classification ('no_change', 'isolated_episode', 'unconfirmed_single_acquisition', 'persistent_change'), direction ('increase' or 'decrease'), sudden, criterion, indicators_driving, onset_measurement_id, onset_acquired_at, onset_coincides_with (qualifications of the onset acquisition) and evidence per bearing label; None unless assessed
assessed.title: Assessed

comparability.description: Comparability of the point's acquisitions: counts per grade, qualifications (code, count, detail), excluded measurements with reasons and collapsed duplicates; None for a miss
comparability.title: Comparability

derived.description: Derived comparisons: deltas per indicator against the reference mean, exceedance_runs, drift regressions, iso_change (change against 25 percent of the ISO 20816-3 B/C boundary when group and support are known) and per_indicator classifications with their criterion; None unless assessed
derived.title: Derived

known_assets.description: Asset ids the ledger directory lists (for a miss); else empty
known_assets.title: Known Assets

known_points.description: Points of a known asset when the point is unknown; else empty
known_points.title: Known Points

lineage.description: Processing lineage the assessment used: processing_id, algorithm_version, covered slots, candidates per lineage, current_processing_id, is_current, missing_for_current, stale_context; None unless assessed
lineage.title: Lineage

lineages.description: Covered evaluated slots per processing lineage ('processing_not_homogeneous')
lineages.title: Lineages

missing_for_current.description: Evaluated slots without a snapshot on the current lineage ('processing_not_homogeneous')
missing_for_current.title: Missing For Current

observed.description: Observed values: reference_statistics per indicator (mean, std, n, band, unit), latest values, latest_measurement_id, latest_acquired_at, evidence_presence per bearing label over the last K acquisitions, indicators_unavailable with reasons, acquisitions_assessed, slots_assessed, measurement_ids_assessed; None unless assessed
observed.title: Observed

reference.description: The reference used: kind ('automatic_window' or 'declared_baseline'), health_declared (True only for a declared baseline), message (cites declared_by, declared_at and note of a baseline verbatim), measurement_ids, count, acquired_from, acquired_to, provisional, statistics_quality ('relative_only', 'provisional', 'full'), qualification_codes of the reference slots, outside_window, baseline, withdrawn_baseline, excluded_inside_span; None for a miss
reference.title: Reference

remedy.description: Concrete action for 'insufficient_history' or 'processing_not_homogeneous': for the latter, the exact re-processing call while a call can act on an evaluated acquisition missing the current lineage, else the actions that close the gap with counts and measurement ids; None otherwise. A call without reprocess_cursor starts a new re-processing sequence, including the call a message, a remedy or a declaration names: start one only when no sequence of the point has ended in the conversation, after the user took an action a sequence listed, after a load or a declaration changed the point, once after an environment fix, or when the user asks to list the blocked measurements again; a named call is an attempt, not a promise that it succeeds. While the reprocess block gives a next_call, make exactly that call. When it gives none, read sequence_state: 'complete' (every stale measurement that represents an acquisition slot has a current snapshot) or 'exhausted' (the measurements under needs_action stay stale until their action is taken; ask the user before any action that is theirs). A new sequence attempts again the failures only an attempt finds (a file rewritten with the same size, a file that no longer decodes), at most 10 attempts, 500 file checks and 50 failures per call.
remedy.title: Remedy

reprocess.description: Outcome of the re-processing call run before the assessment when reprocess=True, None when reprocess was False: processing_id; the counts stale, reprocessed, not_reprocessable, up_to_date, remaining, unresolved, superseded and earlier_in_sequence; sequence_state ('continue', 'complete' or 'exhausted'); groups (the point's measurements in six groups, each with its count, at most 50 measurement_ids and truncated); results (each measurement attempted or found not reprocessable in this call: outcome, reason_code, reason, action_id, location, location_used, attempted, snapshot_id); needs_action (one entry per reason_code with its exact count, at most 50 ids in all, and actions: a list of {action_id, action} that gives once the text of each action_id a failure of this response references, or the plain action of the code when none of its failures is detailed here); earlier_failures (each with reason_code, action_id and location), earlier_by_reason and earlier_not_detailed (what earlier calls of the sequence found; the reasons of failures not detailed are in the responses that found them, or one new sequence lists them again); cursor (the token received), restarted (why a token was not used), next_cursor, next_call (the exact call to make next, or None once the sequence is complete or exhausted) and message. A call without reprocess_cursor starts a new re-processing sequence, including the call a message, a remedy or a declaration names: start one only when no sequence of the point has ended in the conversation, after the user took an action a sequence listed, after a load or a declaration changed the point, once after an environment fix, or when the user asks to list the blocked measurements again; a named call is an attempt, not a promise that it succeeds. While the reprocess block gives a next_call, make exactly that call. When it gives none, read sequence_state: 'complete' (every stale measurement that represents an acquisition slot has a current snapshot) or 'exhausted' (the measurements under needs_action stay stale until their action is taken; ask the user before any action that is theirs). A new sequence attempts again the failures only an attempt finds (a file rewritten with the same size, a file that no longer decodes), at most 10 attempts, 500 file checks and 50 failures per call.
reprocess.title: Reprocess

suggested_verification.description: At most ONE verification sentence the evidence calls for; None when no verification is needed or the point was not assessed
suggested_verification.title: Suggested Verification

suggestion.description: Concrete next step on 'not_found'; None otherwise
suggestion.title: Suggestion

assess_asset_change.title: AssetChangeAssessment

assess_severity.description:
Unified severity assessment result (U9 merge — ``assess_severity``).

Zone boundaries from ISO 10816-3:2009 unless user-defined custom
thresholds were supplied (see ``threshold_provenance``). Covers both
input routes: a stored signal (``signal_id`` set) or a direct broadband
RMS velocity reading (``signal_id`` None). Alert fields
(``alert_level``, ``exceeded_threshold``) are derived from the zone.

alert_level.description: Alert level derived from the zone: A=none, B=warning, C=alarm, D=danger (filled automatically)
alert_level.title: Alert Level

boundaries.description: Zone boundaries {AB, BC, CD} in mm/s (ISO or custom)
boundaries.title: Boundaries

exceeded_threshold.description: The boundary (mm/s) exceeded by the reading (None in zone A; filled automatically from zone + boundaries)
exceeded_threshold.title: Exceeded Threshold

frequency_range.description: Actual evaluation band used (may be narrower than the ISO nominal 10-1000 Hz when fs limits it); 'not applicable' for direct RMS readings
frequency_range.title: Frequency Range

machine_group.description: ISO 20816-3 machine group: 1 (large, >300 kW) or 2 (medium, 15-300 kW)
machine_group.title: Machine Group

machine_power_kw.description: Declared rated machine power in kW, when provided. Values below 15 kW are refused as out of ISO 20816-3 scope.
machine_power_kw.title: Machine Power Kw

operating_speed_rpm.description: Operating speed in RPM, when provided (selects the band's lower edge)
operating_speed_rpm.title: Operating Speed Rpm

signal_id.description: Signal identifier used (None for a direct rms_velocity_mm_s reading)
signal_id.title: Signal Id

status.description: Always 'assessed' — discriminates from a refused result
status.title: Status

threshold_provenance.description: Provenance of the zone boundary values (ISO edition note, or custom-threshold note)
threshold_provenance.title: Threshold Provenance

zone.description: ISO zone: A, B, C, or D
zone.title: Zone

assess_severity.title: VibrationSeverityResult

BearingCandidate.description:
A hypothesis with a significant line of its own and at least one counted
corroborating line.

A significant corroborating line that is shared with another hypothesis or
lies at a shaft order is not counted and does not make a candidate.
Evidence in one envelope spectrum, not a confirmed fault.

fault_type_canonical.description: Canonical fault type (None for arbitrary labels)
fault_type_canonical.title: Fault Type Canonical

level_db.description: Power of the detected line over the local noise floor (dB)
level_db.title: Level Db

BearingCandidate.title: BearingCandidate

BearingClaim.description:
What the bearing check may state from its significance-tested evidence.

Derived from outcome, the per-check states, the declared frequencies and
whether a shaft speed was given; it never changes them. most_likely_fault,
most_likely_fault_canonical and overall_assessment follow it.

acquisition_eligibility.description: known_inapplicable only when the signal's own companion metadata declares a generated signal (a generator key) with a numeric noise_level of 0; unknown otherwise, which is not a validation of the line test's assumptions: no route records what would establish them
acquisition_eligibility.title: Acquisition Eligibility

basis.description: What the claim rests on: the significance-tested lines of one envelope spectrum, never the legacy per-check fields
basis.title: Basis

conditions.description: Why the claim is qualified or withheld; empty for single_spectrum_evidence. generated_without_noise (the signal's own companion metadata declares a generated signal with noise_level 0, outside the line test's model; withheld whatever the outcome), several_types (outcome several_types), cage_comb_not_excluded (the cage line was not testable and a multiple of the declared cage frequency lies in the indicated line's search window), inner_race_sideband_not_excluded (outer race indicated, the inner-race line stands above the floor, and the declared BPFI minus twice the shaft rate lies in the outer-race search window), shaft_tests_not_run (a bearing type indicated by a check that had no shaft speed available, so the shaft-order test did not run and an overlap of the indicated line with a shaft harmonic is not excluded; for an outer-race indication beside an inner-race line above the floor, the inner-race sideband relation could not be tested either; never for a label outside the bearing vocabulary), rolling_element_held_back (a cage held back because the rolling-element line stands above the floor), inconclusive, nothing_testable, no_indication (the outcome itself). The window conditions and shaft_tests_not_run qualify the claim only: outcome, candidates and states stay as tested.
conditions.title: Conditions

level.description: withheld (no fault type is named; the statement says why the record supports none), qualified (the evidence and every competing explanation the result cannot exclude are named, and no single type is singled out) or single_spectrum_evidence (the envelope evidence of this single spectrum is consistent with one type, assuming the record's background is random measurement noise; it asks for confirmation and is not a confirmed fault). A fourth level, supported_claim, is reserved for evidence independent of one spectrum and is never produced by this check.
level.title: Level

limitations.description: Stated with single_spectrum_evidence without changing its level: sideband_only_corroboration (an inner race whose only counted corroborating lines are shaft-rate sidebands, which shaft-rate modulation of the background can also produce), cage_not_declared (no cage frequency was declared, so cage-rate lines were not assessed as an explanation)
limitations.title: Limitations

policy_version.description: Version of the rules that map the evidence to a claim
policy_version.title: Policy Version

BearingClaim.title: BearingClaim

BearingCorroboratingLine.description: One further line the kinematics of a detected line predict.

counted.description: Whether the line counts as corroboration: significant, not at a shaft order and not shared with another hypothesis
counted.title: Counted

excluded_by.description: Why a significant line is not counted, if it is not
excluded_by.title: Excluded By

expected_hz.description: Centre of the search window, anchored at the detected line (Hz)
expected_hz.title: Expected Hz

harmonic.description: Harmonic number for a harmonic; None otherwise
harmonic.title: Harmonic

kind.description: harmonic of the detected line; sideband at the shaft rate (inner race) or the cage rate (rolling element); subharmonic, the 1 x BSF line of the rolling element
kind.title: Kind

level_db.description: Power of that bin over the local noise floor (dB)
level_db.title: Level Db

peak_hz.description: Strongest bin in the window (Hz); None when the window could not be tested
peak_hz.title: Peak Hz

significant.description: Whether the line is a local maximum above its threshold
significant.title: Significant

threshold_db.description: Level the line had to exceed (dB over the noise floor)
threshold_db.title: Threshold Db

untestable_reason.description: Why the line could not be tested; None when it was tested
untestable_reason.title: Untestable Reason

BearingCorroboratingLine.title: BearingCorroboratingLine

BearingEvidencePolicy.description: The statistical policy behind the evidence fields, with its assumptions.

assumptions.description: Statistical assumptions the nominal budgets rest on
assumptions.title: Assumptions

exclusions.description: What the nominal budgets do not cover
exclusions.title: Exclusions

false_alarm_probability_meaning.description: What the per-check budget means, and what it does not
false_alarm_probability_meaning.title: False Alarm Probability Meaning

false_alarm_probability_per_check.description: Nominal family-wise false-alarm budget of one complete check, allocated over its tested hypotheses and their search bins by Bonferroni. Under the assumptions listed, the probability that the check finds a significant line at a tested frequency in a record with no periodic content there is at most this budget; the realized probability is not asserted to equal it. It is not the false-alarm rate or the specificity of the system, not the probability of an indicated outcome, and it applies to one check, not to repeated checks of one machine.
false_alarm_probability_per_check.title: False Alarm Probability Per Check

false_alarm_probability_per_corroboratin.description: Nominal false-alarm budget of each corroborating line, allocated over the bins of its window by Bonferroni
false_alarm_probability_per_corroboratin.title: False Alarm Probability Per Corroborating Line

guard_bins.description: Bins left out between a search window and its reference
guard_bins.title: Guard Bins

harmonics_tested.description: Number of harmonics tested above each detected line, starting at 2x (3 means 2x, 3x and 4x)
harmonics_tested.title: Harmonics Tested

lowest_reference_bin.description: Reference bins start this many bins above 0 Hz, above the leakage of the removed envelope mean
lowest_reference_bin.title: Lowest Reference Bin

min_narrow_window_bins.description: Least half-width of corroborating and shaft-order windows (bins)
min_narrow_window_bins.title: Min Narrow Window Bins

min_reference_bins.description: Fewest reference bins the noise floor needs
min_reference_bins.title: Min Reference Bins

min_reference_bins_per_side.description: Least reference width on each side (bins), where the spectrum allows
min_reference_bins_per_side.title: Min Reference Bins Per Side

min_search_bins.description: Fewest bins a search window needs to be testable
min_search_bins.title: Min Search Bins

narrow_window_fraction.description: Half-width of corroborating and shaft-order windows as a fraction of their frequency
narrow_window_fraction.title: Narrow Window Fraction

reference_width_fraction.description: Reference width on each side, as a fraction of the line frequency
reference_width_fraction.title: Reference Width Fraction

search_window_pct.description: Half-width of each fundamental search window (% of its frequency)
search_window_pct.title: Search Window Pct

usable_band_fraction.description: Lines and reference bins are used only below this fraction of the envelope band width (band high minus band low), which bounds the line frequencies the envelope can carry
usable_band_fraction.title: Usable Band Fraction

BearingEvidencePolicy.title: BearingEvidencePolicy

BearingFaultCheckResult.description: Result of checking for a specific expected fault frequency.

corroboration.description: Further lines tested for a significant line, anchored at it; empty when no significant line was found. Lines of one spectrum are correlated, not independent evidence.
corroboration.title: Corroboration

detected.description: Whether a peak was detected within tolerance. A legacy tolerance match without false-alarm control, kept for compatibility until a later version. The bearing statements and actions of check_bearing_faults, diagnose_vibration and the reports do not use the legacy per-check fields; the asset ledger's evidence-persistence assessment (assess_asset_change) still uses detected, magnitude and evidence_strength until a later version.
detected.title: Detected

detected_frequency_hz.description: Actual peak frequency. A legacy tolerance match without false-alarm control, kept for compatibility until a later version. The bearing statements and actions of check_bearing_faults, diagnose_vibration and the reports do not use the legacy per-check fields; the asset ledger's evidence-persistence assessment (assess_asset_change) still uses detected, magnitude and evidence_strength until a later version.
detected_frequency_hz.title: Detected Frequency Hz

deviation_pct.description: Deviation from expected (%). A legacy tolerance match without false-alarm control, kept for compatibility until a later version. The bearing statements and actions of check_bearing_faults, diagnose_vibration and the reports do not use the legacy per-check fields; the asset ledger's evidence-persistence assessment (assess_asset_change) still uses detected, magnitude and evidence_strength until a later version.
deviation_pct.title: Deviation Pct

evidence_strength.description: Strength of the spectral evidence for this fault: 'high' (fundamental + >=2 harmonics), 'moderate' (fundamental, weaker harmonics), 'low' (harmonics only), or 'none'. Derived from detected peaks, not a probability. A legacy tolerance match without false-alarm control, kept for compatibility until a later version. The bearing statements and actions of check_bearing_faults, diagnose_vibration and the reports do not use the legacy per-check fields; the asset ledger's evidence-persistence assessment (assess_asset_change) still uses detected, magnitude and evidence_strength until a later version.
evidence_strength.title: Evidence Strength

fault_type.description: Checked label: BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF, or an arbitrary user-provided label (e.g. 'GMF')
fault_type.title: Fault Type

fault_type_canonical.description: Canonical fault vocabulary for the standard acronyms (BPFO=outer_race, BPFI=inner_race, BSF=ball, FTF=cage); None for arbitrary labels
fault_type_canonical.title: Fault Type Canonical

harmonics_detected.description: Harmonics found. A legacy tolerance match without false-alarm control, kept for compatibility until a later version. The bearing statements and actions of check_bearing_faults, diagnose_vibration and the reports do not use the legacy per-check fields; the asset ledger's evidence-persistence assessment (assess_asset_change) still uses detected, magnitude and evidence_strength until a later version.
harmonics_detected.title: Harmonics Detected

level_db.description: Power at line_peak_hz over the local noise floor (dB), reported whether or not the line is significant: compare it with threshold_db. It can exceed threshold_db while state is absent when the strongest bin lies on the edge of the search window, where a line outside the window leaks in. None when not testable.
level_db.title: Level Db

line_amplitude.description: Envelope amplitude at line_peak_hz; None when not testable
line_amplitude.title: Line Amplitude

line_frequency_hz.description: Frequency of the line tested (Hz): the expected frequency, or twice the ball spin frequency for the rolling element (detected_frequency_hz is still matched near the ball spin frequency itself)
line_frequency_hz.title: Line Frequency Hz

line_peak_hz.description: Strongest bin in the search window of the line tested (Hz), whether or not it is significant; None when not testable
line_peak_hz.title: Line Peak Hz

line_test.description: How the line was tested; None when not testable

magnitude.description: Magnitude at detected frequency. A legacy tolerance match without false-alarm control, kept for compatibility until a later version. The bearing statements and actions of check_bearing_faults, diagnose_vibration and the reports do not use the legacy per-check fields; the asset ledger's evidence-persistence assessment (assess_asset_change) still uses detected, magnitude and evidence_strength until a later version.
magnitude.title: Magnitude

shared_with.description: Labels of the other detected hypotheses whose search window, or the window of a harmonic, sideband or 1 x BSF line they predict, holds this hypothesis's detected line
shared_with.title: Shared With

state.description: Significance-tested evidence for this hypothesis on the check's envelope spectrum: not_testable (the record cannot test its line), absent (no eligible peak, a local maximum strictly inside the search window, above threshold_db), unconfirmed (a line without a counted corroborating line, a line at a shaft order, or a cage line that a significant rolling-element line can explain), shared (another tested hypothesis also predicts a line where this line lies), supported (a significant line of its own with at least one counted corroborating line its kinematics predict). detected and evidence_strength come from an older tolerance match without false-alarm control and can disagree with state.
state.title: State

state_reason.description: Why the hypothesis is in its state
state_reason.title: State Reason

threshold_db.description: Level the line had to exceed (dB over the local noise floor) for its share of the check's false-alarm budget; None when not testable
threshold_db.title: Threshold Db

BearingFaultCheckResult.title: BearingFaultCheckResult

BearingLineTest.description: How the line of one hypothesis was tested against the noise floor.

false_alarm_probability.description: Nominal false-alarm budget allocated to this line's test over all its search bins together: the check's budget split evenly over the hypotheses it could test. It is not a measured probability for this record. The per-bin value is this divided by search_bins.
false_alarm_probability.title: False Alarm Probability

reference_bins.description: Reference bins on both sides of the search window (N)
reference_bins.title: Reference Bins

reference_rank.description: Rank k of the reference power taken as the noise floor (the median rank)
reference_rank.title: Reference Rank

search_bins.description: Frequency bins searched for the line (M)
search_bins.title: Search Bins

BearingLineTest.title: BearingLineTest

check_bearing_faults.description: Summary of all expected-frequency checks for one bearing/machine.

bearing_id.description: Bearing designation (catalog route); None for the explicit-frequencies and explicit-geometry routes
bearing_id.title: Bearing Id

candidates.description: Supported hypotheses, listed by level over the noise floor; the order does not rank which type is more likely or more severe. One entry for indicated, two or more for several_types, empty otherwise.
candidates.title: Candidates

claim.description: What the check may state from its significance-tested evidence: level, conditions, limitations and the acquisition eligibility the signal's own metadata declares. most_likely_fault, most_likely_fault_canonical and overall_assessment follow it.

evidence_policy.description: Statistical policy and assumptions behind the evidence fields

most_likely_fault.description: The one supported label, derived from claim and set only when claim.level is single_spectrum_evidence: evidence of this single spectrum, not a confirmed fault. None at qualified and withheld. The name is kept for compatibility; it is not a probability ranking.
most_likely_fault.title: Most Likely Fault

most_likely_fault_canonical.description: Canonical form of most_likely_fault; None when most_likely_fault is None or its label is outside the bearing vocabulary
most_likely_fault_canonical.title: Most Likely Fault Canonical

next_step.description: What to do next for this outcome; None when the check suggests no step (every hypothesis was tested and none stands out), which does not mean the bearing is free of defects. It describes the evidence outcome before the claim: when claim.level is not single_spectrum_evidence, do not relay it to name a fault type or a single element; overall_assessment states what the claim allows.
next_step.title: Next Step

outcome.description: Significance-tested outcome of the check on one envelope spectrum: indicated (exactly one hypothesis supported: the evidence is consistent with that defect, not a confirmation of it), several_types (two or more supported, none singled out), inconclusive (a line without a counted corroborating line, at a shaft order or shared, a cage line that a significant rolling-element line can explain, or nothing testable), no_indication (no eligible peak at a tested frequency satisfies the detection criteria, which is not proof that no defect exists). Each check's detected and evidence_strength come from an older tolerance match without false-alarm control and can disagree with outcome; most_likely_fault and overall_assessment derive from claim.
outcome.title: Outcome

outcome_reason.description: Why the check reached its outcome, naming every hypothesis the record could not test. It describes the evidence outcome before the claim: when claim.level is not single_spectrum_evidence, do not relay it to name a fault type or a single element; overall_assessment states what the claim allows.
outcome_reason.title: Outcome Reason

overall_assessment.description: One statement derived from claim: at single_spectrum_evidence, what the envelope evidence of this single spectrum is consistent with and the assumption it rests on; at qualified, the evidence and the competing explanations it cannot exclude; at withheld, why no fault type is assessed. It is not a probability and not a confirmation.
overall_assessment.title: Overall Assessment

declare_measurement_point.description:
Outcome of ``declare_measurement_point``.

The declaration is versioned per point in the local append-only asset
ledger. A re-declaration identical to the current version appends
nothing and reports the current version; a different one appends the
next version and names the keys that changed. The count of recorded
measurements whose snapshot no longer matches the declared context is
reported, never applied silently, with the exact re-processing call when
a call can act on one of them. A call without reprocess_cursor starts a
new re-processing sequence, and a named call is an attempt, not a
promise that it succeeds; while the reprocess block gives a next_call,
make exactly that call; when it gives none, read sequence_state and
report the measurements under needs_action; a new sequence attempts
again the failures only an attempt finds.

appended.description: True when a new declaration version was appended to the ledger; False when the declaration equals the current version
appended.title: Appended

asset_id.description: Asset the point belongs to (ledger id)

bearing_in_catalog.title: Bearing In Catalog

changed.title: Changed

declaration.title: Declaration

declaration_version.description: Version of the point's declaration after this call (1-based, per point); unchanged when nothing was appended
declaration_version.title: Declaration Version

event_id.description: Id of the appended ledger event; None when nothing was appended
event_id.title: Event Id

measurements_with_stale_context.description: Recorded measurements of the point that lack a health snapshot computed with the current declared context and the current processing lineage; their existing snapshots are kept
measurements_with_stale_context.title: Measurements With Stale Context

previous_version.description: Version this declaration supersedes; None for a first declaration
previous_version.title: Previous Version

remedy.description: The exact assess_asset_change(..., reprocess=True) call to attempt the stale snapshots, bounded per call, when a stale measurement passes the checks re-processing reads from the ledger and is not a recording collapsed into another acquisition slot; None otherwise, and the message counts the stale measurements by reason. A call without reprocess_cursor starts a new re-processing sequence, including the call a message, a remedy or a declaration names: start one only when no sequence of the point has ended in the conversation, after the user took an action a sequence listed, after a load or a declaration changed the point, once after an environment fix, or when the user asks to list the blocked measurements again; a named call is an attempt, not a promise that it succeeds. While the reprocess block gives a next_call, make exactly that call. When it gives none, read sequence_state: 'complete' (every stale measurement that represents an acquisition slot has a current snapshot) or 'exhausted' (the measurements under needs_action stay stale until their action is taken; ask the user before any action that is theirs). A new sequence attempts again the failures only an attempt finds (a file rewritten with the same size, a file that no longer decodes), at most 10 attempts, 500 file checks and 50 failures per call.
remedy.title: Remedy

What the bearing check may state from its significance-tested evidence.

Derived from outcome, the per-check states, the declared frequencies and
whether a shaft speed was given; it never changes them. most_likely_fault,
most_likely_fault_canonical and overall_assessment follow it.

acquisition_eligibility.description: known_inapplicable only when the signal's own companion metadata declares a generated signal (a generator key) with a numeric noise_level of 0; unknown otherwise, which is not a validation of the line test's assumptions: no route records what would establish them
acquisition_eligibility.title: Acquisition Eligibility

basis.description: What the claim rests on: the significance-tested lines of one envelope spectrum, never the legacy per-check fields
basis.title: Basis

conditions.description: Why the claim is qualified or withheld; empty for single_spectrum_evidence. generated_without_noise (the signal's own companion metadata declares a generated signal with noise_level 0, outside the line test's model; withheld whatever the outcome), several_types (outcome several_types), cage_comb_not_excluded (the cage line was not testable and a multiple of the declared cage frequency lies in the indicated line's search window), inner_race_sideband_not_excluded (outer race indicated, the inner-race line stands above the floor, and the declared BPFI minus twice the shaft rate lies in the outer-race search window), shaft_tests_not_run (a bearing type indicated by a check that had no shaft speed available, so the shaft-order test did not run and an overlap of the indicated line with a shaft harmonic is not excluded; for an outer-race indication beside an inner-race line above the floor, the inner-race sideband relation could not be tested either; never for a label outside the bearing vocabulary), rolling_element_held_back (a cage held back because the rolling-element line stands above the floor), inconclusive, nothing_testable, no_indication (the outcome itself). The window conditions and shaft_tests_not_run qualify the claim only: outcome, candidates and states stay as tested.

level.description: withheld (no fault type is named; the statement says why the record supports none), qualified (the evidence and every competing explanation the result cannot exclude are named, and no single type is singled out) or single_spectrum_evidence (the envelope evidence of this single spectrum is consistent with one type, assuming the record's background is random measurement noise; it asks for confirmation and is not a confirmed fault). A fourth level, supported_claim, is reserved for evidence independent of one spectrum and is never produced by this check.

limitations.description: Stated with single_spectrum_evidence without changing its level: sideband_only_corroboration (an inner race whose only counted corroborating lines are shaft-rate sidebands, which shaft-rate modulation of the background can also produce), cage_not_declared (no cage frequency was declared, so cage-rate lines were not assessed as an explanation)

Under the assumptions listed, the probability that the check finds a significant line at a tested frequency in a record with no periodic content there is at most this budget; the realized probability is not asserted to equal it. It is not the false-alarm rate or the specificity of the system, not the probability of an indicated outcome, and it applies to one check, not to repeated checks of one machine.

input routes: a stored signal (``signal_id`` set) or a direct broadband
RMS velocity reading (``signal_id`` None). Alert fields
(``alert_level``, ``exceeded_threshold``) are derived from the zone.

bearing_check.description: Whether the bearing check ran. A bearing_faults of None alone does not say whether a check was requested: status 'not_computed' means one was (a bearing_id, or fault_orders declared on the measurement point) and it did not run (reason_code, reason, remedy).

bearing_faults.description: Bearing fault results; None when the check did not run (see bearing_check)

bearing_id.description: Bearing designation given (explicit or from the point), whether or not its check ran; None without one, also for a point that declares fault_orders only (see bearing_check)
bearing_id.title: Bearing Id

evidence_strength.description: Combined evidence across the analyses that ran: 'none', 'weak', 'moderate', or 'strong'. It counts findings (ISO severity zone C or D, a dominant peak at 1x or 2x shaft speed, the bearing claim, the anomaly model) and never rests on severity alone. It is not a probability and does not identify or confirm a fault type. A bearing finding counts once: at claim level single_spectrum_evidence, or qualified from an indicated or several_types outcome; a withheld claim and one held back as inconclusive count nothing. 'none' means the analyses that ran found nothing to count, which does not establish that the machine is healthy; a bearing check that was not computed (bearing_check.status 'not_computed') adds nothing and says nothing about the bearing.
evidence_strength.title: Evidence Strength

iso_severity.description: ISO severity assessment, or a structured refusal (status='refused' with reason + remedy) when the verdict cannot be produced honestly — e.g. undeclared signal unit or Nyquist below the ISO evaluation band. The other diagnosis blocks (spectral, bearing, anomaly) still run.
iso_severity.title: Iso Severity

machine_group.description: ISO 20816-3 machine group used for severity: 1 (large) or 2 (medium)
machine_group.title: Machine Group

parameter_sources.description: Origin of each diagnostic parameter, keyed rpm, bearing_id, machine_group and support_type. Precedence: 'explicit' (passed to the call) > 'measurement' (the rpm declared in the companion's "measurement" object) > 'point' (the current declaration of the measurement point in the asset ledger: nominal_rpm, bearing_id, machine_group, support_type) > 'default' (the historical machine_group=2 / support_type='rigid'; rpm has no default and is refused instead). bearing_id only: 'none' (no bearing from any source, bearing block skipped) or 'not_supported_fault_orders' (the point declares fault_orders without a bearing_id: the bearing block was not computed because frequency sets are not supported by diagnose_vibration in this stage; use check_bearing_faults(frequencies=...)).
parameter_sources.title: Parameter Sources

support_type.description: Support type used for severity: 'rigid' or 'flexible'
support_type.title: Support Type

estimate_rul.description:
Remaining Useful Life estimate from repeated measurements over time.

RUL is only physically meaningful when fitted on a degradation trend
across multiple measurements of the same machine (days/weeks/months).
``fit_r_squared`` describes how well the degradation curve fits the
observed series; it is NOT a probability that the estimate is correct.
Extrapolation beyond the observation horizon is inherently uncertain.

estimated_rate.description: Estimated degradation rate in feature units per time_unit (linear/kalman)
estimated_rate.title: Estimated Rate

fit_r_squared.description: R-squared of the fitted degradation curve on the observed data. Goodness of fit only — NOT a confidence or probability. None for the kalman method.
fit_r_squared.title: Fit R Squared

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the outcome and its caveats
message.title: Message

method.description: Estimation method used: linear, exponential, or kalman
method.title: Method

num_measurements.description: Number of measurements in the series
num_measurements.title: Num Measurements

observation_horizon.description: Time span covered by the measurement series (last minus first timestamp), in time_unit. RUL estimates far beyond this horizon are extrapolations with low reliability.
observation_horizon.title: Observation Horizon

precision_heuristic.description: Heuristic in [0,1]: 1 - rul_std/rul, clipped (kalman only). This is a heuristic, NOT a statistical confidence — do not present it as a probability of correctness.
precision_heuristic.title: Precision Heuristic

rul.description: Estimated remaining useful life in time_unit (only when status='estimated')
rul.title: Rul

rul_interval_95.description: [lower, upper] approximate 95% interval from the delta-method variance (kalman only). Coverage not validated — treat as an order-of-magnitude band.
rul_interval_95.title: Rul Interval 95

status.description: 'estimated' (RUL computed), 'no_degradation_trend' (no statistically significant trend toward the threshold — healthy outcome, no RUL number), or 'threshold_already_exceeded' (last measurement is at/above the failure threshold).
status.title: Status

time_unit.description: Unit of timestamps, observation_horizon, and rul
time_unit.title: Time Unit

trend_p_value.description: Two-sided p-value of the series' linear slope (None when not computable). The trend gate requires p < 0.05.
trend_p_value.title: Trend P Value

estimate_rul.title: RULEstimationResult

segment_duration_s.description: Duration of each segment in seconds
segment_duration_s.title: Segment Duration S

companion_warning.title: Companion Warning

measurement.description: Normalized measurement identity declared in the companion's "measurement" object: asset_id, measurement_point_id, acquired_at (ISO 8601 normalized to UTC), timezone_declared, timestamp_suspect, rpm, load, operating_state, sensor_id, direction, declared_by, measurement_id (first 16 hex of the SHA-256 of the file bytes plus the channel index), channel_index, content_sha256 (full digest of the file bytes) and size_bytes (file size). This block is AUTHORITATIVE over the verbatim object kept in source_metadata. None when the companion declares no measurement object (the file behaves exactly as before). The value RETURNED BY load_signal carries, in addition, the outcome of the asset-ledger registration: ledger_status ('recorded' | 'already_recorded' | 'superseded' | 'not_recorded'), reason (None, or why the status or the snapshot is not nominal), changed (keys that differ from the previous declaration of the same measurement, 'location' when the file moved), reattributed_from (asset the measurement was recorded under by mistake, or None), declaration_version, snapshot_status ('complete' | 'partial' | 'failed' | 'skipped'), snapshot_id, processing_id (the snapshot lineage), comparability ({grade, qualifications} against the current declaration of the measurement point, informational, never stored) and missing ({block: {reason, remedy}} of the snapshot blocks the declared context could not support). get_signal_info and list_signals show the identity only.

get_asset_history.description:
Outcome of ``get_asset_history``: the index of the assets, the history
of one asset, or a typed miss.

``status`` discriminates the three shapes: 'index' (no asset_id given:
``assets`` lists at most the configured number of assets, ``truncated``
says whether more exist), 'found' (``asset`` holds the history read from
that ledger alone) and 'not_found' (an unknown asset or point, with the
known ids and a suggestion; never an exception).

asset.description: History of the asset (status 'found' only): summary, measurements newest first (measurement_id, measurement_point_id, acquired_at, signal_id, location, declaration_version, rpm, direction, sensor_id, lineages, snapshot_count, indicators preview from the latest snapshot, comparability grade and codes against the point), measurement_count, truncated, point_declarations and baselines (current plus history per point), reattributed, integrity, event_count, ledger_bytes
asset.title: Asset

assets.description: Index entries (status 'index' only, else empty): asset_id, points (measurement_point_id, measurement_count, first_acquired_at, last_acquired_at, latest_lineage, baseline_declared, declaration_version), point_count, measurement_count, first_acquired_at, last_acquired_at, reattributed_count, event_count, ledger_bytes, integrity (counters)
assets.title: Assets

known_assets.description: Asset ids the ledger directory lists (the listed ones for the index, every id for a miss; empty for a found asset, whose ledger is the only one read)
known_assets.title: Known Assets

known_points.description: Points of the asset (declared or named by its measurements) when the asset is known; empty otherwise
known_points.title: Known Points

suggestion.description: Concrete next step on a miss; None otherwise
suggestion.title: Suggestion

truncated.description: True when the index holds fewer assets than exist, or the history fewer measurements than max_measurements would have to cover
truncated.title: Truncated

get_asset_history.title: AssetHistoryResult

predict_anomalies.description:
Result of anomaly detection prediction on new data.

Bounded output by design: counts, score percentiles, and the worst
segments only — never per-segment arrays (a 6M-sample signal would
dump tens of thousands of entries into the chat context).

model_name.description: Name of the trained model used
model_name.title: Model Name

score_percentiles.description: Percentiles (p5/p25/p50/p75/p95) of the model decision scores; negative = anomalous side. None when the model exposes no decision_function.
score_percentiles.title: Score Percentiles

segment_duration_s.description: Segment length in seconds (from the model's training metadata)
segment_duration_s.title: Segment Duration S

worst_segments.description: Up to 10 most anomalous segments, each with segment_index, start_time_s, and score (when available) — enough to locate the worst regions without dumping per-segment arrays.
worst_segments.title: Worst Segments

predict_anomalies.title: AnomalyPredictionResult

BearingCatalogMiss.description:
Typed 'not in catalog' result for a bearing catalog lookup.

A missing catalog entry is a legitimate negative outcome, not a tool
failure — the catalog is intentionally small (verified geometry only),
so the miss is expressed in the SCHEMA (status + suggestion) instead of
an ad-hoc dict with an 'error' key. No geometry is ever invented.

bearing_id.description: The bearing designation that was searched for
bearing_id.title: Bearing Id

catalog_contains.description: Designations actually present in the verified catalog
catalog_contains.title: Catalog Contains

status.description: Always 'not_found' — discriminates from a catalog hit
status.title: Status

suggestion.description: Concrete next step to obtain the bearing geometry
suggestion.title: Suggestion

BearingCatalogMiss.title: BearingCatalogMiss
